shared_elements: human figure with head and face depicted
frontal/profile human head with rendered eyes, nose and mouth
headgear or crown above the head
patterned or textured surface treatment (rows of small punched marks / beaded rows)
justification: Both depict human figures with heads bearing some kind of tall headgear and both use rows of small repeated dots/beading as surface texture (the beaded hair and fringes in A, the punched rows on the head in B), but these are generic conventions. A shows a processional file of bearded male figures in profile, full-length, in ceremonial dress with objects and hand gestures, framed by rosette bands; B is a single squat frontal figure with an oversized head and no narrative context, differing entirely in composition, proportion and viewpoint.
